Apple (AAPL) Holding Has Increased by Ctc Llc; Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Position Upped by Bailard Inc
June 23, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Thomas Bailard increased its stake in Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) by 2.7% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bailard Inc bought 2,606 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.03% with the market. The hedge fund run by Thomas Bailard held 99,016 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $12.69M, up from 96,410 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bailard Inc who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $329.48 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.14% or $1.39 during the last trading session, reaching $122.84. About 10.31M shares traded or 54.14% up from the average. Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) has declined 4.75% since June 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.32% the S&P500.
